y-m-16-02.goal: For decimal division where quotient stop at whole-number place, find line where remainder size wrong, choose ways to check remainder, and make your own division problem with remainder.
y-m-16-02.material: Doyun wan pour 8.6 L water into 0.4 L cups, filling each cup full. He find quotient only to whole-number place and also find remainder (water left). Below na Doyun solution. (Count line numbers starting from 1.)

y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.3: So quotient of 8.6 ÷ 0.4 na 21 and remainder na 2.
y-m-16-02.s.s1.line.4: Answer: 21 cups full, and 2 L water remain.

y-m-16-03.topic: Compare fraction and decimal sizes: numbers between two numbers
y-m-16-03.goal: Assess different ways to compare fractions and decimals, then find simplest fractions wey fit conditions between 2 numbers.
y-m-16-03.material:
Seoyeon wan collect fraction cards wey dey between 0.6 and 3/4 (three fourths). First 3 friends use their own methods to say whether 7/12 (seven twelfths) bigger or smaller than 0.6.
Siu: “For 7/12, numerator 7 bigger than 6 in 0.6, so 7/12 bigger.”
Hayoon: “If you divide 7 by 12, you get 0.58333…. Compared with 0.6, 7/12 smaller.”
Dohyun: “I change 0.6 to 3/5, then use common denominator 60 with 7/12. Dem become 35/60 and 36/60, so 0.6 bigger.”
Jihu: “If you change 0.6 into twelfths, e become 7.2/12. Comparing numerators 7 and 7.2, 7/12 smaller.”

y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.a: This compare fraction numerator directly with decimal digit. Fraction denominator 12 and decimal denominator 10 no be same unit, so you no fit compare like this. 0.6
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.b: Hayoon: divide 7 by 12 to change am to decimal, then compare.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.b: This change fraction to decimal to make same form and compare. Also need calculate enough decimal places so difference between 0.583… and 0.6 clear.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.c: Dohyun: change 0.6 to 3/5, find common denominator, then compare numerators.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.c: This change decimal to fraction and compare after making denominators same.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.o.d: Jihu: change 0.6 to fraction with denominator 12 and compare numerators.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.r.d: Even if numerator no be natural number, you fit compare after denominators same. No need reject am just because form unfamiliar.
y-m-16-03.s.s1.explain: Hayoon, Dohyun, and Jihu all compare after putting numbers in same unit/form, so dem valid. Siu directly compare numerator with digit from numbers with different denominators, so e wrong (7/12=0.583… smaller than 0.6). Hayoon method need calculate to point where difference visible, like 0.583… and 0.6.
